name: Forex Fraus M1
summary: Forex Fraus M1 is a 1-minute timeframe scalping EA that enters trades based on a proprietary signal algorithm combining tick-level price movement analysis with volatility filters. It primarily targets small pip gains on M1 charts and uses a momentum-based entry with a fixed take-profit and stop-loss structure. The EA is designed for high-frequency trading on major currency pairs during liquid sessions.
summary_zh: Forex Fraus M1是一个专为一分钟时间框架设计的剥头皮EA，基于结合Tick级价格运动分析与波动率过滤器的专有信号算法入场交易。它主要在M1图表上追求小幅点差收益，使用动量入场配合固定止盈止损结构。该EA专为高流动性时段主要货币对的高频交易而设计。
strategy_analysis: Forex Fraus M1的核心策略是在M1时间框架上捕捉短期价格波动，属于典型的剥头皮交易系统。入场条件基于专有的信号算法，结合Tick级别的价格运动分析和波动率过滤，当检测到短期动量方向时开仓。出场条件使用固定的止盈和止损值，部分版本还包含移动止损功能以锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，但缺乏高级资金管理模块如凯利公式或动态仓位调整。该EA的主要风险在于M1级别的交易频率极高，手续费和点差成本会显著侵蚀利润，尤其是在低流动性时段。此外，策略过度依赖历史回测参数，在市场结构变化时可能出现持续性亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Forex Fraus M1 is to capture short-term price fluctuations on the M1 timeframe, representing a typical scalping trading system. Entry conditions are based on a proprietary signal algorithm that combines tick-level price movement analysis with volatility filters, opening positions when short-term momentum direction is detected. Exit conditions use fixed take-profit and stop-loss values, with some versions including a trailing stop feature to lock in profits. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation from account balance, but lacks advanced money management modules such as the Kelly criterion or dynamic position adjustment. The primary risk lies in the extremely high trading frequency at the M1 level, where commission and spread costs can significantly erode profits, especially during low-liquidity sessions. Additionally, the strategy relies heavily on historically optimized parameters and may experience sustained losses when market structure changes occur.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size, used when MMRec is disabled

pros: 具备点差过滤器，可在高点差环境下避免入场，降低交易成本风险
使用固定的止盈止损结构，每笔交易风险可控且明确
M1时间框架交易频率高，在适合的市场条件下可以快速累积利润
设有魔术编号区分订单，避免与其他EA冲突，便于多EA并行运行
pros_en: Includes a spread filter that prevents entry during high-spread conditions, reducing transaction cost risk
Uses a fixed take-profit and stop-loss structure, making risk per trade controllable and clearly defined
High trading frequency on M1 timeframe can rapidly accumulate profits under suitable market conditions
Employs a magic number to distinguish orders, avoiding conflicts with other EAs and enabling multi-EA operation
cons: M1剥头皮交易受点差和手续费影响极大，实际净收益可能远低于毛收益
策略参数经过历史数据过度优化，存在严重的过拟合风险，实盘表现可能与回测差距很大
缺乏动态仓位管理和加仓/减仓逻辑，无法根据市场变化调整风险暴露
高频率交易对经纪商的执行质量要求极高，滑点可能导致策略失效
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度暴露
cons_en: M1 scalping is heavily impacted by spreads and commissions, making actual net profit significantly lower than gross profit
Strategy parameters appear over-optimized on historical data with serious overfitting risk; live performance may diverge substantially from backtests
Lacks dynamic position sizing and scaling in/out logic, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market changes
High-frequency trading demands excellent broker execution quality; slippage can render the strategy ineffective
No new bar check mechanism may cause repeated entries on the same bar, leading to excessive exposure
improvements: 增加新K线检查机制，确保每根K线只开一次仓，避免重复入场
引入动态仓位管理模块，根据账户权益和近期胜率动态调整手数
增加时段过滤功能，仅在高流动性时段（伦敦/纽约）交易以降低滑点和点差影响
加入市场状态识别模块，在震荡市和趋势市中切换不同的参数集
improvements_en: Add a new bar check mechanism to ensure only one entry per bar, preventing repeated openings
Introduce a dynamic position sizing module that adjusts lot size based on account equity and recent win rate
Add session filtering to trade only during high-liquidity sessions (London/New York) to reduce slippage and spread impact
Incorporate a market regime identification module that switches between different parameter sets for ranging and trending markets

risk_points: M1剥头皮策略的点差和手续费成本占比极高，净收益对经纪商条件极度敏感
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一K线多次开仓，造成过度风险暴露
固定参数策略在市场结构变化时缺乏适应性，可能出现连续亏损
risk_points_en: M1 scalping strategy has extremely high spread and commission cost ratios, making net profit highly sensitive to broker conditions
Lack of new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same bar, resulting in excessive risk exposure
Fixed-parameter strategy lacks adaptability to market structure changes, potentially leading to consecutive losses
